calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year 
FROM dim_date 
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period IN (9, 10, 11)
ORDER BY fiscal_period

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS member_transactions,
  COUNT(*) AS total_transactions,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS member_sales_net,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS total_sales_net
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10, 11)
  AND f.channel_code = 'WB'
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

calls.statement:
SELECT MIN(sale_date) as earliest_sale, MAX(sale_date) as latest_sale
FROM fact_sales_line

SELECT COUNT(*) as web_sales_count
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE channel_code = 'WB'
  AND sale_date BETWEEN '2025-12-22' AND '2026-03-22'

SELECT MIN(sale_date) as earliest_web_sale, MAX(sale_date) as latest_web_sale
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE channel_code = 'WB'

SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_period_label
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE f.channel_code = 'WB' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE f.channel_code = 'WB'
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year

SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_period_label
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE f.channel_code = 'WB' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(f.net_amount), 2) AS share_from_members_pct
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' 
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10, 11)
  AND f.channel_code = 'WB'
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period
